Detailed terrain: WoW Forever client minimap textures (world/minimaps, 512 px per 533-yard map tile, file IDs from each map's WDT), stitched into a zoom pyramid. Painted layer and city maps: WoW Forever client world-map textures (build 1.60.1.70888), placed with the client's UiMapAssignment table. City services (AH, bank, inn, trainers, mailbox, forge…): Wowhead's WoW Forever zone maps. Zone levels: wowhandbook.com. Quests: Wowhead's Forever database (level, faction, class, rewards, Forever changes); start/turn-in positions and chain order: QuestieDB Forever data via wow4ever.quest, plus Wowhead Forever quest maps. Flight masters & towns: Forever client tables. Rares: wow4ever.quest; pins tagged Classic data use warcraftmaps.com Classic 1.12 data. Unofficial fan map, art © Blizzard.
